subject: Draft case study: Nimbus Health — review & quote approvals
messages:
From: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Draft case study: Nimbus & Redwood — first review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the interview last week — the team is excited about the draft case study you shared. I pulled together a few notes after reading through the PDF (attached). High-level: the story reads well, but there are some factual tweaks and one quote we need to reword for legal.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the usage numbers for Q3 that are cited on page 2? We have internal vs. public figures and want the public number to be accurate.
- Please remove our Chief Medical Officer's direct quote (page 4) until our compliance team signs off.
- Minor edits to the timeline (implementation completed in Aug vs. July).

I attached a Word doc with redlines and a screenshot of the logo variant we prefer. If you can share an updated PDF by EOD Thursday (11/13), we can expedite legal review.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Sarah
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Nimbus Health

Attachment: Nimbus_Redlines_20251110.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
Attachment: Nimbus_logo_delta.png (image/png)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Nimbus & Redwood — first review

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick notes and the redline doc. We appreciate the careful review.

Short answers to your bullets:
- Q3 usage numbers: those figures came from our internal telemetry export for the period ending 9/30. We will double-check and swap in the public-safe numbers you prefer. Can you confirm whether you want MAU or API-requests-per-month to be shown?
- Quote removal: absolutely — we'll remove the CMO quote for now and replace it with a paraphrase labeled as "customer-provided summary" until compliance signs off.
- Timeline: we'll update the implementation date to Aug 2025 and mark the change in the revision notes.

Plan: Marissa will incorporate your redlines and produce a v2 PDF by EOB Wednesday (11/12) PST so your legal team has Thursday to review. Laura will update the metrics table and flag any figures that need a source note.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call Wed 11/12 at 10am PT to walk through the remaining items? If not, we'll proceed asynchronously.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: nimbus_case_study_draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf) — placeholder will include tracked changes in the first pass

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Nimbus & Redwood — first review

Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. 10am PT on Wednesday works for us. I've looped in Sarah (again) and our legal lead, Priya Mehra, in case we need a fast sign-off.

Two quick clarifications before the call:
1) On the usage metric, please present both: "API calls/month (public)" and an internal footnote with the normalized requests if that helps. Our comms team prefers the public metric only on the main page.
2) We can grant permission to use the Nimbus logo variant you provided as long as the PNG matches our brand color specs — Priya will confirm on the call.

See you at 10am PT.

--
Tom
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Nimbus Health

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 10:35:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Nimbus & Redwood — first review

Thanks for the call this morning — great to align. Attached is the updated v2 PDF and a CSV with the usage numbers we referenced. Changes made:
- Implementation month corrected to August 2025 (page 2).
- Removed CMO quote; replaced with a short customer-provided summary and labeled accordingly (page 4).
- Metrics table updated and a footnote added: "Public metric = API calls/month; internal normalized figure included in appendix."
- Small copy edits per Sarah's redlines.

Next steps:
- Nimbus: legal to confirm logo color/specs and approve final copy by Friday EOD (11/14).
- Redwood: we will prepare the final production PDF and share the DocuSign permission form for logo usage.

Files attached: Nimbus_Redlines_20251111.docx, nimbus_case_study_draft_v2.pdf, usage_metrics_table.csv

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: nimbus_case_study_draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: usage_metrics_table.csv (text/csv)

From: Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 10:09:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Nimbus & Redwood — final approvals

Marissa / Karthik — we reviewed the v2 PDF and the attachments. Legal and Comms approve with the following final items: 
- Logo: approved variant attached (Nimbus_logo_delta.png) — we request usage in PNG and SVG; please include the color hex #1A73E8.
- Metric wording: keep "API calls/month" as public-facing metric; the appendix may reference internal normalized counts labeled clearly.
- Quote: confirm the CMO is not directly quoted; the paraphrase is OK.

You have our permission to publish the case study and use the logo. Please send the DocuSign logo permission form and the final publication-ready PDF when available.

Thanks for working through this. Looking forward to seeing the published case.

Best,
Priya Mehra
Senior Counsel, Nimbus Health

Attachment: Nimbus_logo_delta.png (image/png)
